intro.en: Jumper harnesses are short interconnects used between boards, modules, terminal points or adjacent devices. Their simple appearance can hide different pin routes, orientation and current requirements.
intro.zh: 跳线线束通常用于电路板、模块、端子点或相邻设备之间的短距离连接。外观虽然简单，但针脚路径、方向和电流要求可能完全不同。

knowledge.en: A jumper may be straight-through, crossed, split or combined with specified components. Connector pitch, keying, terminal plating, conductor size and pull direction affect compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 跳线可能是直通、交叉、分支，也可能按要求集成指定元件。接口间距、防错结构、端子镀层、导体规格和受力方向都会影响兼容性。

notes.en: Confirm both mating interfaces, pin-to-pin table, insertion direction, length reference, current or signal function and whether a sample must be matched. Do not infer a straight-through connection from the connector count.
notes.zh: 需要确认两端对插接口、针脚对应表、插入方向、长度基准、电流或信号功能以及是否需要匹配样品，不能因为两端芯数相同就默认直通。

delivery.en: A first article is built to the approved pin table and dimensional reference. Continuity, polarity where applicable, terminal retention and appearance are checked before the batch is released.
delivery.zh: 首件依据确认的针脚表和尺寸基准制作，并检查导通、适用时的极性、端子保持与外观，确认后再放行批量生产。

subtitle.en: Short interconnections with exact pin routing
subtitle.zh: 短距离连接，也需要精确的针脚定义

lead.en: A jumper harness may be only a few centimetres long, but it is not a generic patch lead. This category includes board-to-board jumpers, terminal jumpers, adapter leads, crossed pin routes, split circuits, service links and short power or signal looms. The correct result depends on both mating interfaces, pin mapping, current or signal function, insertion direction, length datum and the way the jumper is installed and serviced.
lead.zh: 跳线线束可能只有几厘米长，但它不是随手拼接的通用连接线。这个小类包含板对板跳线、端子跳线、转接线、交叉针脚线、分支回路、检修连接线以及短距离电源或信号线束。最终结构取决于两端对插接口、针脚对应、电流或信号功能、插入方向、长度基准以及实际安装与检修方式。

copy.en: Short multi-core links between a main PCB, display, relay board, sensor module or daughterboard. Connector pitch, keying, pin numbering, insertion direction and bend space must match both ends.
copy.zh: 用于主板、显示板、继电器板、传感模块或子板之间的短距离多芯连接，需要同时匹配两端的接口间距、防错、针脚编号、插入方向与弯曲空间。

copy.en: Pre-cut links for adjacent or repeated terminal points, switches, breakers and panel devices. Length, ferrules or terminals, colour and numbering are coordinated with the panel layout.
copy.zh: 用于相邻或重复端子点、开关、断路器和面板器件的预制连接，长度、冷压端头或端子、颜色与线号需要配合面板布局。

copy.en: Converts one connector family, pitch or contact arrangement to another without changing the required electrical function. Both mating part numbers and a confirmed pin table are essential.
copy.zh: 在不改变所需电气功能的前提下，把一种连接器系列、间距或触点排列转接到另一种接口。必须明确两端对插件型号和经过确认的针脚表。

copy.en: Equal contact counts do not guarantee straight-through wiring. Crossed pairs, reversed orientation, keyed housings, polarity and shield or drain positions are documented circuit by circuit.
copy.zh: 两端芯数相同并不代表一定直通。交叉线对、反向插入、防错壳体、极性以及屏蔽或排流线位置，都需要逐回路记录。

copy.en: Connects power entry, fuse, relay, terminal point and local load over a short path. Conductor size, terminal rating, branch loading, voltage drop and protection coordination are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 在短路径内连接电源入口、保险、继电器、端子点与局部负载，需要同时审核导体规格、端子额定、分支负载、压降与保护配合。

copy.en: Used for maintenance access, temporary test connection, module replacement or retrofit work. Clear labels, protected contacts and controlled compatibility help prevent an incorrect connection during service.
copy.zh: 用于检修接入、临时测试、模块替换或改造项目。清晰标签、触点防护与受控兼容关系，可以降低维修时误插误接的风险。

copy.en: Wire size and strand construction are selected from circuit current, voltage drop, flexibility, terminal range and route. PVC, XLPE, silicone, fluoropolymer or another specified insulation is reviewed against temperature, chemicals, movement and applicable equipment documents.
copy.zh: 线径与绞合结构依据回路电流、压降、柔性、端子范围与路径选择。PVC、XLPE、硅胶、氟塑料或其他指定绝缘，需要结合温度、化学环境、运动与适用设备文件审核。

title.en: Connector pitch, keying and housing material
title.zh: 接口间距、防错与壳体材料

copy.en: A visually similar housing may have a different pitch, latch, polarization, cavity numbering or resin grade. Original part numbers, mating samples or verified drawings reduce the risk of a jumper that looks correct but cannot mate.
copy.zh: 外观相似的壳体可能具有不同间距、锁扣、极化方向、孔位编号或树脂等级。原型号、对插样品或已核实图纸，可以降低跳线外观正确却无法对插的风险。

copy.en: Contact plating, compatible wire range, seal range, strip length, crimp tooling and retention feature belong to one termination system. Ring, fork, blade, receptacle, ferrule and connector contacts are not selected by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 触点镀层、适配线径、密封范围、剥线长度、压接工装和保持结构属于同一端接系统。环形、叉形、片式、插簧、冷压端头与连接器端子不能只看外观选择。

copy.en: Heat-shrink, braid, small conduit, terminal boots, cavity plugs and durable labels are added where the route or service method requires them. Exposed contacts and loose short leads need packaging and handling controls as well as electrical design.
copy.zh: 热缩管、编织层、小型套管、端子护套、堵孔件和耐久标签，应在路径或检修方式确有需要时使用。裸露触点和短小散线除了电气设计，还需要包装与搬运控制。

copy.en: The approved table records cavity numbers, wire colours, conductor sizes, circuit names, shields, polarity and any crossed route. The harness drawing adds length datums, connector views, labels and inspection points.
copy.zh: 批准的针脚表记录孔位、线色、导体规格、回路名称、屏蔽、极性与交叉路径；线束图纸再补充长度基准、接口视图、标签和检验点。

title.zh: 依据样品开发但不猜测

copy.en: A reference jumper helps confirm dimensions, connector orientation and visible materials. Hidden pin routes, ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance requirements are verified separately before the sample is copied.
copy.zh: 参考样品可以帮助确认尺寸、接口方向与可见材料，但隐藏针脚路径、额定、镀层、内部接点和验收要求，需要单独核实后再复制。

copy.en: When two modules use different connector families, the jumper is designed as a controlled adapter. Pin function, signal pairing, grounding, shield continuity, voltage and current compatibility are reviewed before defining the mechanical conversion.
copy.zh: 两个模块采用不同连接器系列时，跳线应作为受控转接件开发。先审核针脚功能、信号配对、接地、屏蔽连续性、电压与电流兼容，再定义机械转接。

title.en: Turn a hand-built link into repeatable production
title.zh: 把手工连接转化为可重复生产

copy.en: A temporary field jumper can be converted into a drawing, BOM, controlled lengths, approved terminals, labels and an electrical test program. This creates a replaceable part instead of relying on technician memory.
copy.zh: 临时现场跳线可以转化为图纸、BOM、受控长度、认可端子、标签和电气测试程序，使其成为可替换零件，而不是依赖技术人员记忆。

copy.en: Short links between control boards, displays, motors, switches, sensors and local power points where enclosure space and assembly order are limited.
copy.zh: 连接控制板、显示器、电机、开关、传感器与局部电源点，适用于壳体空间和装配顺序受限的设备。

copy.en: Module jumpers, panel links and replacement adapters for sensors, relays, actuators, I/O points and machine subassemblies.
copy.zh: 用于传感器、继电器、执行器、I/O点和设备子组件的模块跳线、面板连接与替换转接。

copy.en: Defined patch leads and breakout jumpers for development benches, fixtures, measurement modules and engineering validation, with pin mapping that can be reproduced later.
copy.zh: 为开发台、工装、测量模块与工程验证提供受控连接线和引出跳线，并保留可复现的针脚定义。

copy.en: Pre-terminated jumpers between terminal blocks, breakers, relays, switches, door components and cabinet modules, prepared to the panel numbering and routing plan.
copy.zh: 按照面板编号和路径计划，预制端子排、断路器、继电器、开关、柜门器件与柜内模块之间的跳线。

copy.en: Low-level signal, excitation, communication and local power jumpers between instruments, acquisition boards, sensor interfaces and internal modules.
copy.zh: 连接仪器、采集板、传感接口与内部模块的低电平信号、激励、通信和局部电源跳线。

copy.en: Adapter and service jumpers that bridge an available replacement module to an existing machine interface while keeping the approved electrical function traceable.
copy.zh: 用转接或检修跳线把可获得的替换模块接入现有设备接口，同时保持已确认电气功能可追踪。

copy.en: Confirm both mating connector systems, circuit function, voltage, current, signal type, environment, quantity and required records before selecting materials.
copy.zh: 选料前确认两端对插系统、回路功能、电压、电流、信号类型、环境、数量与所需记录。

copy.en: Record cavity-to-cavity routing, connector views, insertion direction, length reference, exposed lead length, bend direction, labels and any straight, crossed or split circuit.
copy.zh: 记录孔位对应、接口视图、插入方向、长度基准、露线长度、弯曲方向、标签以及直通、交叉或分支回路。

copy.en: Prepare conductors to controlled cut and strip lengths, then crimp, solder or otherwise terminate with the approved contact system and tooling.
copy.zh: 按照受控下线与剥线长度准备导体，再使用认可触点系统和工装完成压接、焊接或其他端接。

copy.en: Insert contacts into the correct cavities, set connector orientation, form the short lead without overstressing the wire exit, and apply circuit or part identification.
copy.zh: 把端子插入正确孔位，设定接口方向，在不让出线位置过度受力的前提下完成短线成型，并增加回路或零件标识。

copy.en: Verify the approved pin map, opens, shorts, polarity where applicable, terminal seating, retention, dimensions and visible workmanship before release.
copy.zh: 放行前核对批准针脚表、断路、短路、适用时的极性、端子到位与保持、尺寸和可见工艺。

title.en: First article and controlled batch release

copy.en: The approved sample, drawing, BOM, test program and packaging method become the production reference. Later connector or pin changes are handled as recorded revisions.
copy.zh: 确认样品、图纸、BOM、测试程序与包装方式共同成为生产基准；后续接口或针脚变化通过受控版本处理。

title.en: Wire exit, bend radius and pull direction
title.zh: 出线、弯曲半径与受力方向

copy.en: A short jumper can transfer installation force directly into a terminal. Length, service loop, bend direction, strain relief and pull path are reviewed so the contact is not used as a mechanical anchor.
copy.zh: 短跳线容易把安装力直接传到端子。需要审核长度、余量、弯曲方向、应力防护与拉力路径，避免让触点承担机械固定作用。

title.en: Current, temperature rise and contact resistance

copy.en: Conductor size alone does not define capacity. Terminal family, crimp quality, connector rating, contact resistance, bundling, ambient temperature and duty cycle all affect a short power jumper.
copy.zh: 承载能力不能只看线径。端子系列、压接质量、接口额定、接触电阻、成束、环境温度与工作周期都会影响短距离电源跳线。

copy.en: Dust, moisture, oil, cleaning agents and handling can affect unsealed connectors and exposed terminals. Seals, boots, plugs, sleeves or packaging are specified only for the actual exposure.
copy.zh: 灰尘、湿气、油污、清洁剂和搬运可能影响非密封连接器与裸露端子。密封、护套、堵孔、套管或包装应针对真实暴露环境确定。

copy.en: Continuity confirms circuit routing but does not prove every signal, load or protocol is compatible. Functional, dielectric, insulation, temperature or endurance tests are added only when the project defines methods and acceptance limits.
copy.zh: 导通可以确认回路路径，但不能证明所有信号、负载或协议都兼容。功能、耐压、绝缘、温度或寿命测试，需要项目明确方法与限值后增加。

title.en: Faster installation with fewer wiring decisions
title.zh: 安装更快，现场判断更少

copy.en: Predefined length, connector orientation, pin map and labels remove repeated cutting and point-to-point decisions during equipment assembly or service.
copy.zh: 预先定义长度、接口方向、针脚和标签，减少设备装配或维修时反复下线与逐点判断。

copy.en: A drawing and test map make crossed routes, polarity, shields and special circuits visible to engineering, production and maintenance teams instead of hiding them inside a short cable.
copy.zh: 图纸和测试表让交叉路径、极性、屏蔽与特殊回路对工程、生产和维修团队可见，而不是隐藏在一根短线中。

copy.en: Controlled components, dimensions, labels and inspection records allow a service jumper or retrofit adapter to be reordered without rebuilding it from memory.
copy.zh: 受控器件、尺寸、标签与检验记录，使检修跳线或改造转接件可以重复订购，不必依靠记忆重新制作。

title.en: A small assembly treated as an engineered part
title.zh: 把小组件当作工程零件管理

copy.en: Even a two-wire link receives interface, circuit, material and acceptance definitions appropriate to its function, reducing the risk created by an undocumented improvised connection.
copy.zh: 即使只有两根线，也依据其功能定义接口、回路、材料和验收要求，降低无记录临时连接带来的风险。

q.en: Is a jumper harness always wired straight through?
q.zh: 跳线线束一定是直通的吗？

a.en: No. A jumper can be straight-through, crossed, reversed, split or combined with shields and specified components. The approved pin-to-pin table is the production and test reference.
a.zh: 不一定。跳线可以直通、交叉、反向、分支，也可能包含屏蔽或指定元件。批准的针脚对应表才是生产与测试依据。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both connector and mating part numbers, a pin table, circuit function, voltage and current, length datum, wire and colour requirements, environment, quantity and inspection requirements. Photos or samples can supplement missing drawings.
a.zh: 建议提供两端连接器及对插件型号、针脚表、回路功能、电压与电流、长度基准、线材与颜色要求、环境、数量和检验要求。照片或样品可以补充不完整的图纸。

q.en: Can a jumper be developed from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品开发跳线吗？

a.en: Yes, but a sample cannot reveal every rating or hidden circuit reliably. Pin mapping, conductor specification, terminal system, plating, polarity and acceptance criteria still need confirmation before repeat production.
a.zh: 可以，但样品不能可靠展示全部额定或隐藏回路。重复生产前仍需确认针脚、导体规格、端子系统、镀层、极性与验收标准。

q.en: How should jumper length be measured?
q.zh: 跳线长度应该怎样测量？

a.en: The drawing should define the datum, such as connector face to connector face, wire exit to wire exit or cut length. It should also state whether the jumper is straight, naturally laid or formed during measurement.
a.zh: 图纸应明确基准，例如接口端面到端面、出线口到出线口或下线长度，并说明测量时线束是拉直、自然放置还是已经成型。

q.en: Can a different connector replace the original one?
q.zh: 可以使用其他连接器替代原接口吗？

a.en: Only after reviewing mating fit, cavity numbering, terminal system, current, voltage, temperature, material, keying, locking and installation space. A similar shell shape is not evidence of compatibility.
a.zh: 必须审核对插、孔位编号、端子系统、电流、电压、温度、材料、防错、锁止与安装空间。壳体外观相似不能证明兼容。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?

a.en: Finished jumpers receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels, insulation or other electrical and mechanical checks are added according to the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品跳线进行导通与外观检查。针脚对应、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签、绝缘或其他电气与机械项目按批准的项目计划增加。
